answer.reason: Several events of the story of Esther happened at Shushan: the decree was given there, the city rejoiced, and the Jews fought there.

clauses.english: was where the decree to destroy the Jews was given, and the city was perplexed
clauses.quote: the decree was given in Shushan the palace

clauses.english: rejoiced and was glad when Mordecai went out in royal apparel
clauses.quote: the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad

clauses.english: was where the Jews slew five hundred men
clauses.quote: in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men

doubts: NEH 1:1, EST 1:2, EST 2:3-8 and DAN 8:2 only place someone at Shushan, so they were not used.
The marked verses in EST 11 are from the Additions to Esther (Apocrypha) and describe a dream, not an event at Shushan, so they were left out.
The second day's three hundred slain (EST 9:15) and the hanging of Haman's ten sons (EST 9:14) were left out to keep the line short.
